# Task
This network is a surrogate inside a materials discovery loop. Inputs are the first 50 principal components of mean-pooled ORB-v3 node embeddings of a crystal. The target is the bulk modulus from a Birch-Murnaghan fit, computed with the eSEN-30M-OAM potential. Training rows are the loop's warm-start pool (500 known structures); test rows are the structures a generator (MatterGen, CrystalFlow or ADiT) proposed in one run while being steered toward high values (65 to 92 per run, 6 runs; the seed picks the run). Each input has been standardised to zero mean and unit variance on the training rows. The output y is the bulk modulus in GPa.

The network was trained on 500 rows whose target has mean 134.6 and standard deviation 72.14 GPa. The loop cares most about the candidates with the highest true values, and those are the ones this network gets wrong. Its errors on training rows it had not seen (five-fold cross-validation), grouped by decile of the true value:
